We're building the QA pipeline for FortuneLottery Inc.'s new metaphysics-based recommendation feature. The product team has left a task specification at `config/qa_task.json` that describes what sample report needs to be generated for validation.

Please read that spec and produce the prediction report file it describes (`prediction_report.txt`). The report must include the metaphysical derivation details (the three hexagrams and their basis numbers) as well as the recommended lottery numbers, and must follow all standard output conventions for this type of report.
